journeys.label: Universal Safety Fallback Journey
journeys.description: Safe 1:1 stage-to-level mapping fallback used if any custom journey configuration is missing or corrupted. Ensures the client always receives a valid level without crashing.

journeys.label: Boss Rush & Hardcore Crucible
journeys.description: Starts directly with Tier 5 near-boss and chapter climax levels (Levels 40-50) from Stage 1 for high-friction player testing.

journeys.label: Hybrid Multi-Phase Journey
journeys.description: Multi-tier journey: Stages 1-20 (Linear Onboarding), Stages 21-80 (Sawtooth Chapter Climaxes), Stages 81-120 (Royal Rhythm Dopamine Loops), Stages 121+ (Endgame Vault).

journeys.label: Linear Ramp Journey
journeys.description: Smooth onboarding journey: monotonic difficulty progression from Tier 1 through Tier 5.

journeys.label: Royal Rush Journey
journeys.description: High-octane dopamine flow: rapid clears, intense color clusters, and fast-paced cascade loops across 100 royal levels.

journeys.label: Sawtooth Waves Journey
journeys.description: Standard live-ops journey: recurring chapters with periodic boss climax spikes and post-boss recovery breather levels.

cohorts.label: Casual / Relaxed Cohort
cohorts.description: Accessible difficulty. Always defaults to Forgiving seed (+40% ammo buffer) to minimize churn and maximize player comfort.

cohorts.label: Core / Balanced Cohort
cohorts.description: Standard balance. Starts on Calibrated seed, silently swaps to Forgiving on consecutive fails, and tests mastery with Tight on high win-streaks.

cohorts.label: Veteran / Hardcore Cohort
cohorts.description: High friction and tight economy. Defaults to Tight seed (+12% ammo buffer) for core players seeking mastery and high challenge.

cohorts.label: Universal Safety Fallback Cohort
cohorts.description: Safe default loaded if any custom cohort name is missing or invalid. Always serves Calibrated seed with standard 2-fail pity.
